messages.content: How do I set up a vLLM server for inference?

Here's how to set up vLLM for high-performance inference:

## Installation
```bash
pip install vllm
```

## Start Server
```bash
# Basic server
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model meta-llama/Llama-3.2-8B-Instruct \
    --port 8000

# With GPU memory optimization
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model meta-llama/Llama-3.2-8B-Instruct \
    --port 8000 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
    --max-model-len 4096
```

## API Usage
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1",
    api_key="not-needed"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="meta-llama/Llama-3.2-8B-Instruct",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
```

vLLM provides excellent throughput with PagedAttention!

For multi-GPU inference with vLLM:

## Tensor Parallelism
```bash
# Use 2 GPUs with tensor parallelism
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model meta-llama/Llama-3.2-70B-Instruct \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
    --port 8000

# Use 4 GPUs
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model meta-llama/Llama-3.2-70B-Instruct \
    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
    --port 8000
```

## Docker with Multi-GPU
```bash
docker run --gpus all \
    -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
    -p 8000:8000 \
    vllm/vllm-openai:latest \
    --model meta-llama/Llama-3.2-8B-Instruct \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2
```

## Pipeline Parallelism (for very large models)
```bash
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model meta-llama/Llama-3.2-405B-Instruct \
    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
    --pipeline-parallel-size 2
```
